visual_review.subject: A perspective cube displayed on a mobile phone with a bottom divider.
visual_review.keyshape_reason: VRECT_L preserves the upright phone silhouette.
references: Supplied reference: retained phone, bottom divider and three cube faces.
Lucide smartphone and box originals and atomic-debug: rounded phone corners and shared cube vertices.
visual_review.review: Both themes and sizes inspected. Phone and cube are readable, but cube face openings are too tight. MIC failures remain on cube edges, seams and footer. Retained for manual review.
visual_review.asymmetry: Phone and cube are mirrored about x=24; perspective face arrangement follows the reference.
